surfaces.reason: The renderer runs once per tool call with no reader in scope. The owner path normally carries no attendee_status (B3, byte-identical), and does carry it when the owner searches for a flexible requester (ignore_attendee_availability), which is B1's shape.
The colleague path is where annotateSlotsWithAttendeeStatus always runs, and it is the incident's own surface; B1's fixture is that search's result shape.
The incident is a 1:1 DM (thread 1789371421.383909); the tool line is produced identically in any conversation.

summarizeToolCall takes tool name, input, result and the owner timezone only — no surface, authority or senderRole enters it — so a channel/MPIM turn produces the identical line. The marker never reaches a reader: tool summaries go to the prompt and history, never into a posted message.

The dependency here is the per-attendee calendar read itself. When it did not happen or returned nothing the status is 'unknown' and no marker is emitted (B2); when the annotation is absent entirely the line is unchanged (B3). The renderer cannot throw on either shape — both are plain reads of optional arrays.
